listingDraft.shortDescriptionEs: Descubre coches de alquiler para tu viaje.
listingDraft.shortDescriptionEn: Find rental cars for your journey.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEs: Encuentra empresas de alquiler de coches y explora sus vehículos con AkiCoches. Busca por destino, consulta ubicaciones en el mapa y revisa información de la flota y disponibilidad publicada. Cuando esté disponible, envía una solicitud de alquiler al proveedor; la confirmación depende del operador.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEn: Find car rental companies and explore their fleets with AkiCoches. Search by destination, browse rental locations on the map and review published vehicle details and availability. Where available, send a rental request to the provider. Requests require operator confirmation.

delivery.android: Android App Bundle (.aab) signed for Play App Signing, not generated
delivery.ios: Signed .ipa archive and TestFlight build, not generated

notes: Do not insert app signing keys, provisioning profiles, personal details, reviewer passwords or store API keys in Git.
Do not publish android/.well-known/assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association with guessed fingerprints/team IDs.
Respect AkiSuite cross-domain OAuth callback and application deep linking; each product must survive login, logout and password recovery.
No automatic purchase-flow enabling: review mobile digital subscription rules and local availability before release.
